decks.notes: The main concept of this deck revolves around aggressive gameplay and utilizing the Rakdos color combination. The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. Key cards include Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser as strong threats, accompanied by a variety of removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill. The deck also includes discard spells such as Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt opponents' strategies. It has a versatile land base with various utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear, providing additional advantages in different scenarios.

This deck is centered around the Lotus Field combo, using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to quickly ramp up your mana and maximize the potential of Lotus Field. The deck focuses on card selection and card advantage, with cards like Impulse, Pore Over the Pages, and Bala Ged Recovery to ensure you have the right cards at the right time. There are also various tutors like Dark Petition and Mastermind's Acquisition to search for key combo pieces, and powerful payoff cards like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience to seal the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly pressuring the opponent with efficient creatures and removal spells while disrupting their game plan with hand disruption. By combining aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Graveyard Trespasser with powerful spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the board and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of high-impact finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger gives the deck additional staying power and versatility in different matchups. The deck is designed to overwhelm opponents and secure victories through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The key concept of this UW Control deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from developing a board presence. Cards like Strict Proctor and Narset, Parter of Veils help shut down the opponent's strategies, while Teferi, Hero of Dominaria provides card advantage and control over the game. The deck also includes powerful board wipes like Supreme Verdict and Doomskar to maintain control of the battlefield. Additionally, the inclusion of Lotus Field and Hengegate Pathway allows for efficient mana generation and flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive gameplay style. By utilizing low-cost creatures such as Ornithopter, Thraben Inspector, and Voldaren Epicure, the deck aims to establish a strong early board presence. Key cards like Reckless Bushwhacker, Venerated Loxodon, and Resolute Reinforcements provide additional means to boost the power of the creatures and deliver substantial damage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Giant Killer to hinder the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck's goal is to quickly defeat the opponent through an aggressive and efficient playstyle.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards with high green devotion to ramp up mana quickly and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By using cards like Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck aims to power out threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll early in the game. Additionally, Storm the Festival can provide card advantage and further ramp capabilities, while Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures offer additional utility and protection for the deck's key threats.

This deck revolves around the concept of high-speed aggressive play using the Arclight Phoenix as its centerpiece. By utilizing cards such as Ledger Shredder, Picklock Prankster, and Various spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe, it aims to quickly burn down opponents. The deck also includes card draw and selection options like Consider, Sleight of Hand, and Opt to ensure consistent access to key cards. Otherworldly Gaze provides graveyard manipulation, while Spell Pierce offers some protection against opponent's spells. The strategic use of Spell Pierce and efficient card draw with Treasure Cruise enables the deck to maintain a steady flow of threats and maintain control of the game. The deck is supported by land cards that enable various color options and provide mana acceleration.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing powerful creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bonecrusher Giant to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional value and threats. With a mix of removal spells and efficient creatures, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through aggressive plays and strategic disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to flood the board with green mana-producing creatures and ramp spells to get to high mana quickly. This allows for playing powerful green spells and creatures like Polukranos Reborn, Old-Growth Troll, and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck also utilizes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to search for key pieces in the deck. The inclusion of Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Nissa, Who Shakes the World, helps to take advantage of the high devotion to green mana symbols in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive gameplay focused on green devotion. By utilizing cards such as Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, and Wolfwillow Haven to ramp up mana quickly, the deck aims to play powerful green creatures like Polukranos Reborn and Old-Growth Troll. Additionally, cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner help to generate card advantage and provide additional value. The inclusion of Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Lair of the Hydra further enhances the deck's devotion to green, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming board presence.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Lotus Field and other support cards to set up powerful combo plays, such as casting Emergent Ultimatum or resolving Omniscience. It uses bounce effects like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings to untap lands and generate additional value. The sideboard likely contains cards to protect the combo, disrupt opponents, and adapt to different matchups. Overall, the strategy is to assemble key pieces while efficiently managing resources to overwhelm opponents with game-winning plays.

This deck revolves around the concept of utilizing Lotus Field as a central combo piece. The goal is to ramp quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, while also finding Lotus Field with Sylvan Scrying and Thespian's Stage. Once Lotus Field is on the battlefield, players can generate a large amount of mana and execute powerful combo plays using cards like Discontinuity, Pore Over the Pages, and Emergent Ultimatum. The deck also includes support cards like Hidden Strings and Dark Petition to assist with card selection and searching for key combo pieces.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of efficient removal and disruption to control the game. It utilizes powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bonecrusher Giant to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support these aggressive plays with a mix of dual lands and utility lands. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through a combination of early aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on using creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester to repeatedly sacrifice and deal damage to the opponent, while also utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil and Claim the Firstborn to gain advantage from sacrificing creatures. The key strategy is to create a loop of sacrificing and dealing damage to the opponent while disrupting their hand and board state with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional mana fixing and support for the aggressive sacrifice strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of sacrificing creatures, dealing direct damage, and disrupting their game plan. By utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Bloodtithe Harvester, along with Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, the deck aims to control the board and chip away at the opponent's life total. Additionally, cards like Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn provide disruption and help maintain the tempo of the game. The deck's mana base allows for consistent casting of spells while also providing flexibility in terms of color requirements.

The main concept of this deck is to generate mana quickly using creatures like Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, and Paradise Druid, along with mana-generating artifacts like Mox Amber. This fast mana is then used to cast powerful combo pieces like Retraction Helix and Bring to Light. The deck also includes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Rona, Herald of Invasion to provide additional utility and disruption. The combination of these cards allows the player to assemble powerful and game-winning combinations quickly, putting pressure on the opponent and overwhelming them with efficient plays.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 aggro-auras deck focuses on exploiting the power of auras to quickly enhance its creatures and overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a strong companion card, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional value. The main deck consists of low-cost creatures like Gladecover Scout and Skrelv, Defector Mite, supported by a variety of enchantments like Ethereal Armor, All That Glitters, and Cartouche of Solidarity. With a mix of protection spells and evasion cards like Audacity and Gryff's Boon, the deck aims to create highly efficient and potent creatures that can easily dominate the battlefield.

The focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to flood the board with low-cost creatures like Ornithopter and Thraben Inspector, supported by powerful anthem effects like Venerated Loxodon and Resolute Reinforcements to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck also includes cards like Clarion Spirit and Legion's Landing to generate additional tokens for aggression, while Legion Loyalist and Reckless Bushwhacker provide additional burst damage potential. The land base is designed to ensure a consistent mana base for early aggression, with utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire for additional advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to build a fast and aggressive board presence using cheap, efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Favored Hoplite. The deck also includes strong combat tricks and protection spells like Reckless Rage and Gods Willing to push through damage and protect your creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha as a Companion adds consistency and extra mana ramp. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent quickly with a mix of creature aggression and spell support to secure a victory in the early turns of the game.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels. It also utilizes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Secrets of the Key to create additional token copies of creatures for added pressure. The deck includes various spells for removal and card advantage, as well as lands that enable consistent mana fixing. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with large threats and card advantage.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly ramp up to high amounts of green mana using mana dorks and enchantments like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The deck also utilizes cards with powerful green devotion like Old-Growth Troll and Nissa, Who Shakes the World to take advantage of that high mana production. Additionally, Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide extra value and threats to overwhelm the opponent quickly in an aggressive manner.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize green mana and devotion to power up the creatures on the battlefield quickly. By ramping up with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the deck aims to flood the board with impactful threats such as Polukranos Reborn and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to further accelerate mana production. The presence of Karn, the Great Creator offers utility and flexibility, while cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide card advantage and support.

The key concept of this deck revolves around utilizing control elements of Dimir colors to disrupt opponents' strategies and gain advantage. This is achieved through a combination of counterspells like Negate and Sinister Sabotage, removal spells such as Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict, and card draw/manipulation with Memory Deluge and Change the Equation. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and The Meathook Massacre allows the deck to close out games once control has been established. The deck also takes advantage of various utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Vantress to further enhance its control capabilities.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to continuously search for and tutor powerful creatures. The variety of creatures in the deck allows for adaptability to different situations, while the Fires of Invention spell provides additional mana for playing multiple spells in a turn. Leyline Binding helps to control the opponent's board, while Temporary Lockdown and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide extra disruption. With a mix of powerful creatures and control spells, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a slow and controlled manner.

This deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for creatures in response to different situations, utilizing control elements like Fires of Invention and Leyline Binding to maintain board dominance. The deck also includes a variety of powerful creatures with impactful abilities, such as Agent of Treachery and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines, as well as a mix of support cards like Destiny Spinner and Chained to the Rocks. With Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, this deck aims to control the battlefield and outvalue opponents through strategic creature selection and management.

The deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss to create an infinite loop with Parhelion II, generating a win condition through an endless stream of Angel tokens. The deck includes various cards for graveyard recursion, card draw, and disruption to support the combo. It aims to efficiently assemble the combo pieces while controlling the board with removal spells and hand disruption. The deck also includes some versatile cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship to provide additional threats and value.

Utilize cards like Lotus Field, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Hidden Strings to generate massive amounts of mana and cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience quickly. The deck aims to set up a strong board state and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of ramp, card advantage, and game-changing spells. Win conditions include casting large spells for free, creating infinite mana loops, or overwhelming the opponent with a massive burst of spells in a single turn. The deck is designed to be able to quickly assemble its key pieces and execute its game plan efficiently.

The main concept of this deck revolves around the combo potential of Neoform Atraxa. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to perform the combo and win the game. It utilizes cards like Grisly Salvage and Otherworldly Gaze to dig for combo pieces, while also running backup creatures like Questing Beast and Nighthawk Scavenger for additional utility. Atraxa, Grand Unifier serves as a key combo piece, allowing for multiple activations of Neoform. The deck also incorporates cards like Urborg Scavengers and Soulflayer to expand its options and maintain flexibility. Supporting cards like Samut, Voice of Dissent and Oracle of Tragedy help to further enable the combo strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed with a mix of shocklands and fastlands to ensure consistent mana production.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to deal damage to the opponent and control the board. It aims to generate value through recurring creatures like Cauldron Familiar and exploiting sacrifice triggers with cards like Mayhem Devil. The addition of Jegantha as a companion provides an additional mana source and support for the aggressive, sacrificing strategy. The deck includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize to disrupt opponents' strategies and removal spells like Fatal Push to eliminate threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and resource manipulation.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponents' spells, wiping the board when necessary, and generating value through card draw. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset to control the battlefield, while also using cards like Absorb and Settle the Wreckage to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of cards like Shark Typhoon and Metropolis Reformer allows for alternate win conditions, while the land base provides flexibility and consistency for setting up the control game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through efficient control strategies.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures like Strict Proctor, while drawing cards and gaining card advantage with Teferi, Memory Deluge, and Impulse. The deck aims to protect itself with Dream Trawler and Shark Typhoon, eventually winning the game through alternate win conditions like Approach of the Second Sun or overwhelming the opponent with card advantage and threats. The land base includes utility lands like Castle Vantress and Hall of Storm Giants to further control the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board by utilizing counter spells, removal, and disruption while generating card advantage. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and eventually take over the game during the late stages with powerful finishers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon. It also includes land destruction elements and options for card draw to maintain a steady stream of resources. The deck is built to outlast aggressive strategies and establish a dominant position in the mid to late game.
